clues.text: After Noah left the ark, God set it in the clouds as a sign that no flood would destroy the earth again.
God told Noah that whenever He formed clouds over the earth, this would appear in them.
God told Noah that when He saw it, He would remember His everlasting covenant with every living creature.
Ezekiel saw the glory of the LORD shining like this, then fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
In Ezekiel's vision, the brilliant light around the figure on the throne looked like this in a cloud on a wet day.
In John's vision of heaven, one gleaming like an emerald encircled the throne.
John saw a mighty angel come down wrapped in a cloud, with this above his head and a face like the sun.
